title: service-messaging: the e-mail channel reports available on a LogTransport, so a send with no mail transport reads as delivered while nothing is sent (objectstack-ai/cloud#2549 ruling B, item ③)
body:
repo:cloud#3 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjRhUZjdy8VXs6Kkur2

Filing gate: **executing a recorded ruling.** The maintainer ruled objectstack-ai/cloud#2549 **B**; their selection, verbatim, is 「B 只让租户自配邮箱」 (ruling record on that card). This card is item ③. Item ② (approvals request e-mail) is a sibling card.

**Owner.** The `repo:cloud` lane (`repo:cloud#3`, objectstack-ai/objectstack#30278) follows it to close; triage routes it. Priority p3, inherited from objectstack-ai/cloud#2549.

## 维护者速读

环境没配发信方式时，邮件服务会用一个「只写日志」的假通道：发信调用返回成功、写一条发信记录，实际一封没发。邮件渠道还把自己报告成「可用」。结果是任何要求发邮件的通知或流程都以为已送达。改成：只写日志时，邮件渠道如实报告「未配置发信」，让投递记录和界面都显示真相。

## Measured (objectstack `origin/main` `48231b02`; cloud `e91d1472`; read-only)

- `packages/services/service-messaging/src/email-channel.ts` ~:341-345: `isAvailable()` is true whenever an `email` service object exists, otherwise `{available:false, reason:'transport_not_configured'}`. It does not ask which transport the service holds.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-email/src/email-plugin.ts`: `provider` defaults to `'log'` (~:456). With none configured it logs "no transport configured — using LogTransport (mail will NOT be sent)" (~:494). It binds to the `mail` settings namespace on `kernel:ready` and hot-swaps the transport (~:615-652).
- In cloud, every hosted tenant kernel force-mounts `email` (`apps/objectos/hosted-slate.ts:92`) without a transport (`packages/objectos-runtime/src/capability-loader.ts:524`), so every hosted environment is in this state until its admin configures `mail`.
- Not measured: an actual send on a tenant kernel. The "reports success, writes `sys_email`, delivers nothing" behaviour is quoted from cloud's `capability-loader.ts` comment (~:1022-1027).

## Expected

- `plugin-email` exposes whether its current transport is real (not the LogTransport), in a form the channel can read.
- `email-channel.isAvailable()` answers `{available:false, reason:'transport_not_configured'}` while the transport is the LogTransport. It flips back without a restart when `mail` settings hot-swap a real transport in.

## Acceptance

- A test proves a kernel with no `mail` settings has the e-mail channel unavailable, with that reason, and no fake delivery row.
- A test proves that after a settings hot-swap to a real transport the channel is available.
- The existing messaging tests stay green.

Dedupe (2026-11-05): `repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack email channel LogTransport available is:issue` → 3 hits (QA runs only); `transport_not_configured is:issue` → 4 hits, all closed (#18567, #18050, #17732), none on the LogTransport case.
